reference: T005 isolated native wx.request ordinary HTTP probe executed on the actual target iPhone under WeChat DevTools 真机调试 (LAN), with server-side peer/UA logging: 10/10 probe cases PASS covering request success, method/path/query/headers, status and body reading, HTTP vs network error, bounded timeout, RequestTask.abort, success/fail/complete ordering, single terminal settlement, late success/failure suppression, and an independent PATCH runtime risk probe whose actual method was observed server-side.
environment: Device: iPhone 16 (iPhone17,3), iOS 26.6.2, WeChat 8.0.80, runtime base library SDK 3.18.1 as printed by the probe page. Runtime path: WeChat DevTools cask 2.02.2609250 (app build 36.6.0) 真机调试 over LAN, not the Simulator. Probe server: Node 26.13.0 on macOS 26.6.2 arm64 listening on http://192.168.2.135:8791 (all interfaces), logging the peer address and User-Agent; phone peer 192.168.2.212, UA MicroMessenger/8.0.80 NetType/WIFI. Isolated technical probe only: no backend, production service, real family data, or credentials involved.

operations.action: Start the existing isolated technical probe server on the LAN and confirm the phone can reach it
operations.expected: An isolated HTTP probe service is reachable from the actual phone on the same Wi-Fi, without exposing any production service, real data, or credentials
operations.actual: Probe server listened on 0.0.0.0:8791 (http://192.168.2.135:8791); first phone request GET /ok arrived from peer 192.168.2.212 with UA Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 26_6_2 like Mac OS X) ... MicroMessenger/8.0.80 NetType/WIFI, proving the request originated on the phone rather than the IDE Simulator

operations.action: GET /ok with X-Probe-Header and read status, body, and response header
operations.expected: 200 with a parsed JSON body and the response header, exactly one success settlement followed by complete
operations.actual: PASS settled=1 status=200 callbacks=success|complete header=ok 1282ms; body {"probe":true}

operations.action: GET /echo?a=1&b=two with X-Probe-Header and verify the server-observed method, header, and query
operations.expected: The server observes GET, the custom header, and both query parameters, and the response is typed-read as JSON
operations.actual: PASS status=200 server saw method=GET header=fe-001 query={"a":"1","b":"two"}

operations.action: GET /unauthorized and distinguish an HTTP error from success
operations.expected: 401 is returned as an HTTP response with the generated Error code, not treated as success

operations.action: GET /missing and read a non-success HTTP status
operations.expected: 404 is returned with code NOT_FOUND and is not treated as success

operations.action: Trigger a network-layer failure without an HTTP response
operations.expected: The platform reports a fail callback with an error message, settles once, and produces no success
operations.actual: PASS settled=1 fail=request:fail errcode:-312 cronet_error_code:-312 error_msg:net::ERR_UNSAFE_PORT callbacks=fail|complete lateSuccess=false; the refusal on port 1 is rejected client-side as an unsafe port, which is still a network-layer failure distinct from any HTTP status

operations.action: Request /slow?ms=2200 with timeout 800 and observe bounded timeout plus delayed callbacks
operations.expected: The request fails with a timeout, completes, settles once, and no delayed success alters the settled result
operations.actual: PASS settled=1 fail=request:fail timeout callbacks=fail|complete lateSuccess=false; the observation window exceeded the 2200 ms server delay

operations.action: Issue /slow?ms=2200 and call RequestTask.abort after 300 ms
operations.expected: The request fails with an abort, completes, settles once, and no late success or late failure alters the result
operations.actual: PASS settled=1 fail=request:fail abort callbacks=abort-called|fail|complete lateSuccess=false lateFail=false; observation continued past the 2200 ms server response time

operations.action: Repeat a normal /ok request and count terminal callbacks
operations.expected: Exactly one terminal callback; success/fail are not both delivered
operations.actual: PASS settled=1 callbacks=success|complete with exactly one terminal callback

operations.action: PATCH /method with a JSON probe body and a diagnostic method cast (probe only)
operations.expected: Record whether the runtime sends PATCH and what the client callback observes, without using Method Override
operations.actual: PASS status=200 clientObserved=PATCH callbacks=success|complete fail=null; official miniprogram-api-typings 5.3.1 omits PATCH from RequestOption.method, so this isolated probe uses a diagnostic type cast; no method override header or second DTO was used

operations.action: Read the server observation log to confirm the actual HTTP method received for /method
operations.expected: The server itself records a real PATCH request, independent of the client callback
operations.actual: PASS serverSawPatch=true; server log entry "SERVER-OBSERVED PATCH /method {"probe":true} remote=192.168.2.212" and /observed response contain the PATCH entry from the phone

operations.action: Judge PATCH runtime support and formal strongly-typed feasibility separately
operations.expected: Runtime support and type-level feasibility are recorded independently without overstating either
operations.actual: Runtime support: PASS (the phone runtime transmitted PATCH and the server observed it). Formal strongly-typed feasibility: feasible only through a narrow typed boundary escape because the official 5.3.1 typings omit PATCH; this is not a FE-001 hard gate and does not authorize Method Override, a second DTO, or backend contract changes. Downstream business capabilities that use PATCH remain a separate dependency risk.

operations.action: Upload the probe summary from the phone to the probe server and display it on screen
operations.expected: The phone shows the complete summary and the upload is observed server-side
operations.actual: Phone displayed passed=10 total=10 with results and "results upload sent"; server logged POST /results from peer 192.168.2.212 with the same summary, platform ios, model iPhone 16<iPhone17,3>
